source_evidence: The finding's insight is now expressed in live source, not a plan: src/flic.cpp:35 holds the active TU-wide `struct Buffer;` forward, and the src/flic.cpp:18-34 comment records exactly this discovery's two measured directions - a TU-wide forward keyed the unit U and emitted init's PAU name, while use-site `struct Buffer *` spellings at the declaration re-keyed nothing - i.e. VC6 fixes the U/V key at the first visible tag declaration with no per-use-site override.

The buffer-side lever the finding said was required is applied inside the already-expanded scope: src/buffer.h:500-609 defines the seven-argument `Buffer::copy` (0x005DFF00) in-class since 2026-09-17, with the comment stating the image's own copy was header-inline so the U-keyed flic TU emitted its own PAU COMDAT alongside the PAV one and the linker ICF-folded them - the only way one image holds both spellings; src/buffer.cpp:1492-1566 retains the ORIGINAL marker and full history beside `// body src/buffer.h`, matching the framework-coordinator's 2026-09-17 inline-restore grant for exactly this repair, so no further expansion is needed (src/buffer.h and src/buffer.cpp are already in the task's editable files).

Fresh diagnostics in this request confirm the emitted-name half of the hypothesis: the binary check now locates `?init@Flic@@QAEHPAUBuffer@@PADHHH@Z` in src/flic.cpp with boundary pass under both configured flag trials (functions array, init result unknown solely for reference-target reasons) - the catalogued PAU name the discovery measured as unreachable from flic-only spellings is now emitted.

Incorporation is expression, not acceptance or resolution of the remaining tails: the same fresh check still reports obligation-f60db6a6 (?UNK9@Flic@@QAEXXZ, 0x0062B780) unknown with reason 'unresolved targets: ?copy@Buffer@@QAEHPAU1@HHHHHH@Z', init unknown on unresolved ??_C@_02JKAF@rb?$AA@, ?PaletteCurrent@@3PAVPalette@@A and the PAU copy, twelve known idiomatic decoder mismatches plus ??1Flic@@QAE@XZ fail, and layout witness coverage remains incomplete - all preserved; nothing is demoted, no baseline, flag set or claim changes.
The sibling finding worker-a9127a8663c94a6f817a0e488a0bc86f remains pending for its own separate decision, and this incorporation grants no acceptance, worker permission or Git publication.
